$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].comment: Need to verify of CP offence codes can be mapped to DLRM offence codes

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Allows for multiple offences
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: Number starting at 1

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The date the defendant was charged
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: See CJS Standard [2] section 3.46 for date format. Date must not be in the future.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The code for the offence date to be used within the offence wording, e.g., "1" is used where the date does not specify a particular day or a particular day and month, e.g., "In July 2000", "In the year 1997".
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: See CJS Standard [2] section 3.80 Values: 1 = on or in 2 = before 3 = after 4 = between 5 = on or about 6 = on or before

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Date offence committed, Or start date for period in which offence committed
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: See CJS Standard [2] section 3.46 for date format Date must not be in the future.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: End date for period in which offence committed
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: See standard [2] section 3.46 for date format Mandatory if Offence Date Code = 4. Otherwise field must be blank. Day Number or both Day and Month Number in the date may be zero. Date must be after the Offence Start Date and must not be in the future.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Date arrested
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: See CJS Standard [2] section 3.46 for date format Date must not be in the future.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Method by which alcohol or drugs level measured
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: ALCOHOL LEVEL METHOD* [3] This is to be provided for drink driving or drug driving offences.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The amount of alcohol or drugs present in the blood, urine or breath of the defendant.
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: ALCOHOL LEVEL AMOUNT [3] Mandatory if Alcohol Level Method field populated. Otherwise null.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Free text description of the location where the offence was committed
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: Must be included where the CJS Offence Code full offence wording includes a location element.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Details of Information or Charge to be laid before the court
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: See CJS Data Standards [2] section 3.134. Does not include the legislative element of the offence.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Details of Information or Charge to be laid before the court in Welsh
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: See CJS Data Standards [2] section 3.134. Does not include the legislative element of the offence. If the document language is Welsh then the correct format is English wording and Welsh wording (optional).

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Statement of facts
Statement of facts in Welsh
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: Where a Statement of Facts is supplied, and the documentation language is W Welsh, then a Welsh statement of facts should be supplied

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: Compensation claimed by the prosecutor.
Identifies offences involving an LGV or PCV that are of interest to the DfT. Previously known as Vehicle Type.
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: L = Large Goods Vehicle or Passenger Carrying Vehicle, O = Other

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: For traffic related prosecutions
For traffic related prosecutions

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].comment: true/false based on whether prosecutor wants to offence AOCP on a particular offence

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The latest plea for this offence.
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: Please see "Plea Types" tab for values

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The date the plea has been submitted.
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: To be provided where a Plea has been provided.

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The verdict given by the courts for this offence
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: Please see "Verdict Types" tab for values

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The verdict date.
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: To be provided where a Verdict is present

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The conviction date
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: Provided where there has been a conviction

$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].description: The allocation decision (model of trial) made regarding the jurisdiction required or elected for dealing with the offence in question and based on the indicated plea. Useful from an MI perspective.
The date on which the decision the allocation was made
$.migratedCase.defendants[*].offences[*].businessRules: Should be provided if allocation decision is provided
